help.Der PC baut die Verbindung zum Board auf: The PC opens the connection to the board (TCP 3240), so no firewall rule is needed on the PC. If the device is unplugged at the board, the PC drops the connection. After plugging it in again, run attach again.
help.<b>Hostname</b>: Name des Boards im Netz: Hostname: name of the board on the network. It also announces itself via mDNS as <hostname>.local and advertises the service _usbip._tcp.
help.<b>DHCP</b> (Standard): Die Adresse verg: DHCP (default): the router assigns the address. To keep it the same, set up a fixed assignment in the router (Fritzbox: Home Network → Network → edit device → "Always assign this network device the same IPv4 address").
help.<b>Statische IP</b>: Haken bei DHCP entf: Static IP: untick DHCP, enter address, mask, gateway and DNS. The address must be free and outside the router's DHCP range.
help.Änderungen gelten erst <b>nach einem Neu: Changes apply only after a restart (System → Restart). Then open the page at the new address.
help.Auf Desktop-Systemen meist schon eingeri: Usually already set up on desktop systems (avahi). Otherwise:
help.In <code>/etc/nsswitch.conf</code> bei <: In /etc/nsswitch.conf, add mdns_minimal [NOTFOUND=return] to the hosts: line before resolve.
help.Windows 10/11 löst <code>.local</code>-N: Windows 10/11 resolves .local names by itself. If not, use the IP address.
help.Ohne Passwort ist die Oberfläche nur les: Without a password the web UI is read-only. Settings can only be changed once a password is set.
help.Haken setzen, Benutzername eintragen und: Tick the box, enter a user name and the password twice (against typos), then Save Auth Settings. The browser will then ask for the credentials when opening the page.
help.Passwort ändern: neues in beide Felder e: Change the password: enter the new one in both fields. Leave both empty = the current password stays.
help.Nach 5 falschen Versuchen sperrt das Boa: After 5 wrong attempts the board blocks further logins from this PC for 30 seconds.
help.Ohne HTTPS geht das Passwort unverschlüs: Without HTTPS the password crosses the LAN unencrypted. Protection: HTTPS (panel "Encryption") or open the web UI via WireGuard.
help.<b>Passwort vergessen</b>: am Board <b>R: Forgot the password: press RESET 5 times in a row on the board (less than 5 s between presses) – this resets everything to factory settings. Or erase only the settings over the USB cable, the firmware stays: idf.py -p /dev/ttyACM0 erase-region 0x9000 0x6000 (Windows: -p COM3 or similar). All settings are lost (including WireGuard and TLS keys).
help.<b>Open</b>: Jeder im Netz darf USB/IP u: Open: everyone on the network may use USB/IP and this web UI.
help.<b>Closed (Allowlist)</b>: Nur eingetrag: Closed (Allowlist): only listed participants get access, both to USB/IP and to this web UI. An entry is either an IP or a MAC address, plus a comment so it stays clear whom you gave access.
help.<b>MAC statt IP</b>: praktisch, wenn der: MAC instead of IP: handy if the PC sometimes gets a different IP via DHCP. Works only for PCs in the same LAN (the board reads the MAC from its ARP table), not across WireGuard or a router. A MAC can be spoofed – it is a convenience, not strong protection. For real protection: password, TLS or WireGuard.
help.<b>Diesen PC eintragen</b> übernimmt IP: Add this PC takes the IP or MAC of the PC you are sitting at (choose the type first).
help.Der PC, von dem aus du speicherst, wird: The PC you save from is added to the list automatically, so you cannot lock yourself out.
help.Mit WireGuard die <b>Tunnel-IP</b> des P: With WireGuard, enter the PC's tunnel IP (e.g. 10.8.0.1), not its LAN address.
help.Eigene IP- bzw. MAC-Adresse herausfinden: Find your own IP or MAC address:
help.„IPv4-Adresse“ bzw. „Physische Adresse“: "IPv4 Address" or "Physical Address" (MAC) of the Ethernet or Wi-Fi adapter.
help.Das Panel erscheint, sobald das Board ei: This panel appears as soon as the board has detected a USB hub.
help.<b>Problem</b>: Langsame Geräte (Full/Lo: Problem: slow devices (Full/Low Speed) such as a YubiKey, keyboard, mouse or many USB serial adapters do not work behind a USB 2.0 hub. The ESP32-P4's USB library would need a "transaction translator" for that, which it does not have yet. The event log then shows "FS/LS device rejected (no TT support)".
help.<b>Hub-Kompatibilität an</b>: Der USB-An: Hub compatibility on: the board's USB port works at Full Speed only (12 Mbit/s). Then the hub and all devices behind it run at Full Speed too, and YubiKey & co. work on the hub.
help.<b>Nachteil</b>: Auch USB-Sticks und Kar: Drawback: USB sticks and card readers then also run at Full Speed only – about 1 MB/s instead of 5–6 MB/s. Without a hub or with only fast devices on the hub: leave it off.
help.Wirkt erst nach einem <b>Neustart</b> (S: Takes effect only after a restart (Save & Restart). All attached devices are disconnected.
help.Hub ohne eigenes Netzteil: Geräte können: Hub without its own power supply: devices may drop out briefly or be detected slowly. For several devices use a powered hub.
help.Eingeschaltet bietet das Board nur die a: When enabled, the board only offers the listed devices. It ignores all others as soon as they are plugged in.
help.Format <code>VID:PID</code> in Hex, durc: Format VID:PID in hex, separated by commas. * stands for all products of a vendor, e.g. 1050:* = all YubiKeys.
help.Die Liste wirkt beim Anstecken. Bereits: The list applies when a device is plugged in. Unplug devices that are already connected and plug them in again.

help.Hier gibt es zwei getrennte Funktionen f: There are two separate functions for the local network here. Via WireGuard both are already encrypted, so these functions are not needed then.
help.<b>1. USB/IP über TLS</b>: Das Board nim: 1. USB/IP over TLS: the board additionally accepts encrypted connections on port 3241. On the PC stunnel does the encryption, and usbip only talks to 127.0.0.1.
help.<b>Additional</b>: unverschlüsselt (3240: Additional: unencrypted (3240) and TLS (3241) at the same time, good for switching over.
help.<b>TLS only</b>: Das Board lehnt unversc: TLS only: the board refuses unencrypted connections, all PCs need stunnel. Connections through the WireGuard tunnel stay allowed, they are already encrypted. A refused PC reports Exported Device List Request failed - Unknown Op Common Status.
help.In der Geräteliste kennzeichnet ein Schl: In the device list a lock with "TLS" or "WireGuard" marks encrypted USB/IP connections.
help.<b>Show key &amp; stunnel config</b> → L: Show key & stunnel config → Linux. Save the block up to the line ciphers as /etc/stunnel/usbip.conf, and the line Kennung:Schlüssel as /etc/stunnel/usbip.psk:{P0}

help.Klappt das, auf <b>TLS only</b> umstelle: If that works, switch to TLS only.

help.Das Board baut den Tunnel selbst zu eine: The board itself builds the tunnel to a peer: this PC, your own server or a router such as a Fritzbox. Then USB/IP and this web UI are reachable encrypted at the tunnel address . When the page is opened that way, "Protected by WireGuard" is shown at the bottom left, and devices with tunnel clients carry a lock.

help.Prüfen: In der App erscheint „Letzter Ha: Check: the app shows "Latest handshake". Then (as administrator):{P0}
help.<b>Über das Internet</b>: Als Gegenstell: Over the internet: the peer is then a server or router with a public address. Peer endpoint is its domain or IP, e.g. the Fritzbox VPN under Internet → Permit Access → VPN (WireGuard). Peer config snippet shows the matching [Peer] block for the peer. The tunnel network must not overlap with the local networks. In ACL mode "Closed", allow the PC's tunnel IP. Status "waiting for time sync" means: the board cannot reach an NTP server yet (internet required).
help.<b>Kein Handshake</b> („connecting · no: No handshake ("connecting · no handshake"): usually the PC's firewall blocks UDP 51820 or a key is mixed up. Check with sudo tcpdump -ni any udp port 51820: if packets from the board arrive, the keys are the problem. After restarting the tunnel on the PC, the board reconnects only after up to about 2 minutes. It is faster to switch Enable off and on again here.
help.<b>Energiesparen</b> (ab Werk an): Ohne: Power save (on by default): without an attached device the CPU runs at 100 MHz instead of 400 MHz. As soon as a device is attached it goes to full clock, so transfers do not get slower. Unticked, the board runs at 400 MHz all the time. Takes effect immediately, without a restart. When it is on, the green leaf is shown at the bottom left.
help.<b>Restart</b>: startet das Board neu. E: Restart: restarts the board. Attached USB devices are disconnected on all PCs and must be attached again with attach afterwards.
help.<b>Factory Reset</b>: löscht <b>alle</b>: Factory Reset: erases all settings (network, password, ACL, device filter, WireGuard and TLS keys) and restarts. Afterwards DHCP without a password applies.
help.<b>Ohne Web-UI zurücksetzen</b>: die <b>: Reset without the web UI: press the RESET button on the board 5 times in a row, less than 5 s between two presses (good: about once per second). On the 5th start the board erases all settings like Factory Reset. Power off/on counts the same. A single reset or power failure does nothing; crashes are not counted. The BOOT button cannot be used for this (pressed at power-on = flash mode, in operation Ethernet uses the pin).
help.<b>Firmware-Update</b>: per USB-Kabel mi: Firmware update: over the USB cable with idf.py -p /dev/ttyACM0 flash (Windows: -p COM3 or similar). The settings are kept.
